doctrines.desc: Love is beautiful and sacred, no matter the form it takes. Everyone should be permitted to love and do as thou wilt.
doctrines.name: Accepted

parameters.text: Characters with the Deviant Trait are fully accepted

doctrines.name: Criminal

doctrines.desc: Death is a period of mourning and ritual for those who live. Hierarchy and seniority matter as much in death as in life; it is important to venerate those more elderly even after their passing, and to be seen venerating in the correct ways.

It is imperative that all who knew the dead gather and offer their grief in a public show of bewailment. This both honors the dead and cleanses our souls of the grief felt by their departure.
doctrines.name: Bewailing Burial

parameters.text: The Funeral Activity offers more opportunities to reduce Stress

doctrines.desc: From ashes we came, to ashes we return. The body of our deceased is disposed of in a great funeral pyre, and the resulting ashes are spread across the earth to continue the journey of the dead.
doctrines.name: Cremation

doctrines.desc: The dead should not be imprisoned underground — it is far better to allowed them to be consumed by scavenging birds, where in a final act of generosity they can feed the world which fed them.

doctrines.desc: Not all among the gentility dwell in sin. There are those who respect God's chosen people, and these deserve a measure of our respect in turn.
doctrines.name: Teachings of Moses

parameters.text: Faiths with Jewish Syncretism are considered Hostile
Mutual … Opinion bonus with Faiths that have the Jewish Syncretism Tenet

doctrines.desc: Together we are bound not by a single faith, but by the many faiths that make up the religious fabric of our society. Though we may call ourselves different names and follow different paths, some from outside our own belief system have learned to coexist in our society as if they were one of us.
doctrines.name: Sinitic Cosmology

parameters.text: Faiths with Sinitic Syncretism are considered Astray
Mutual … Opinion bonus with Faiths that have the Sinitic Syncretism Tenet

doctrines.desc: Under traditional Jewish doctrine, a new High Priest can only be named either with the coming of the Prophet or if a descendant of Aaron fit to serve as priest is found.
descVariants: The High Priesthood of this faith has been completely dismantled. Any attempts to name a High Priest would first require a thorough reconstruction of traditional church structure.
doctrines.name: The Prophecy of Malachi

parameters.text: This faith cannot recreate its Head of Faith under normal circumstances.

doctrines.desc: Our priests know that clothes entrap the spirit and prevent us from achieving true enlightenment. Only by shedding our garbs can we awaken our souls and experience … love.
doctrines.name: Naked Priests

parameters.text: Priests and zealous characters do not wear clothes.

doctrines.desc: Our religious leaders have historically been engaged in inter-faith dialogs to increase cooperation amongst the different Christian denominations.
doctrines.name: Ecumenism

parameters.text: Faiths with Ecumenism are considered Astray

doctrines.desc: An Unreformed Faith lacks an organized clergy and established canonical doctrines; different communities can nominally follow the same faith while having wildly different religious practices and beliefs.
